submission.justification: Recommend Mixture-G2 with a 2.1 mm gas gap. Among the candidates, Mixture-G3 gives the fastest simulated timing but is the standard fluorinated mixture and is rejected on the GWP100 policy. Mixture-G1 is the replacement-gas option but does not meet the 1.5 ns timing requirement anywhere in the sampled 1--3 mm gap range. Mixture-G2 is the partial-substitute candidate and is the only option found that combines an environmentally acceptable formulation with simulated timing below the 1.5 ns hard limit. A scan of Mixture-G2 over 1--3 mm showed its optimum near 2.0--2.1 mm; repeated 100k-event Garfield++ runs at 2.1 mm gave 1.23--1.31 ns, with representative result 1.23 ns and all repeats comfortably below 1.5 ns.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Mixture-G1, Mixture-G2, and Mixture-G3; the selected option is Mixture-G2.

requirements.requirement: The time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.
requirements.evidence: Garfield++ simulations for Mixture-G2 at 2.1 mm returned 1.23, 1.267, 1.216, 1.302, 1.255, 1.291, and 1.310 ns in repeated 100k-event runs; all are <= 1.5 ns.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is the candidate specified as using a partial substitute for the fluorinated component, i.e. the reduced-GWP candidate among the timing-capable mixtures; Mixture-G3 is the standard fluorinated mixture and was excluded. The selected G2 formulation is taken as the policy-compliant candidate.
The selected gap is 2.1 mm, within the allowed 1--3 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Mixture-G2 at 2.1 mm.
